name: mcp-lyricscom
description: MCP server for lyrics.com. Search song lyrics by word or by title, and fetch full lyrics. No API key required.
long_description: Find a song from a word inside its lyrics, or by title, then read the full text. No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_lyrics
tools.description: Find songs containing a word or phrase in their lyrics.

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Find songs by title, optionally narrowed by artist.

tools.name: get_lyrics
tools.description: Read one song's lyrics by id.
